title: Evidence: Package Not Received

attachments.platform_description: Photos taken on January 18th at 5:00 PM showing empty front porch. No package visible anywhere near the entrance, side door, or garage area.
attachments.title: Front Porch Photos

submitted_text:
I was working from home all day on January 18th. My home office faces the front door and I did not see any delivery truck or person approach the house. No doorbell was rung and no knock was heard.

I checked with neighbors on both sides (house numbers 442 and 446) on January 19th. Neither received a misdelivered package.

Unfortunately my Ring doorbell camera was offline from January 17-19 due to a Wi-Fi router replacement. I do not have video footage of the delivery window.

I filed a police report (Report #2024-0118-4532) on January 19th for stolen package / non-delivery.
